status: IMPLEMENTED — join executed by app/scripts/join-mlb-pregame-settlements.mjs (official StatsAPI box scores only). Still NO modeling, calibration, feature scoring, public prediction, or money/official-settlement change. Modeling remains blocked until gateBeforeModeling + founder approval.
purpose: Define how future official results will join to captured pregame snapshots, and how each feature family becomes research-eligible — so a LATER, separate, founder-approved modeling mission can build a leakage-safe dataset without any ambiguity.
procedure: 1. For each event, read the immutable FINAL_PREGAME_FREEZE (freezes/<date>/<gamePk>.json). It references the latest research-eligible pregame snapshot per family.

2. After the game settles, read the OFFICIAL outcome from the existing settlement path (public/data/mlb/results/settled_leans.jsonl — official box-score actual/outcome, joined by id which encodes gamePk+player+market+line).
3. Write a SEPARATE research-join record; NEVER mutate the pregame snapshot or the freeze.
4. A feature family contributes to a row ONLY IF the freeze marks it researchEligible (captured strictly before first pitch with a proven timestamp).

researchJoinRecordShape.pregameFeatures: the eligible family values from the freeze (lineup slot, pitcher status, weather, umpire, ...)

perFamilyEligibilityForResearch.confirmed_lineup: usable when the lineup was CONFIRMED and captured before first pitch (freeze.featureEligibility.confirmed_lineup.available)
perFamilyEligibilityForResearch.pitcher_status: usable when the probable/confirmed starter matches the settled pitcher and no superseding change occurred pregame
perFamilyEligibilityForResearch.environment: usable when a pregame weather forecast/condition + roof status was captured (never the observed postgame weather)
perFamilyEligibilityForResearch.umpire: usable when the home-plate umpire assignment was captured pregame (never the final box-score umpire)
perFamilyEligibilityForResearch.markets: IMPLEMENTED (the-odds-api). TEAM markets (h2h/spreads/totals): join by gamePk + market + selection + line. PLAYER props (pitcher_strikeouts/outs/earned_runs, batter_hits/total_bases/home_runs/rbis/runs_scored/hits_runs_rbis): join by gamePk + player/playerId + market + selection + line to the official box score (settled_leans.jsonl by id, or StatsAPI box score by playerId+gamePk). De-vig reproducible from paired two-sided prices; over-only props carry noVigProbability:null and join as market context (never de-vigged, never inferred). All immutable + timestamp-safe. The market remains the benchmark — a family is 'incremental' only if it beats the de-vigged market out of sample (a later mission).
perFamilyEligibilityForResearch.bullpen: usable once the strict completed-before-capture builder is added
perFamilyEligibilityForResearch.plate_appearance_opportunity: usable once markets (team/game totals) are archived across the window

leakageRules: Post-start snapshots and unproven timestamps are excluded (enforced by researchEligible).
Final box-score lineups/umpires/pitch-counts NEVER backfill a missing pregame family.
The market remains the benchmark; a family is 'incremental' only if it beats the de-vigged market out of sample (a later mission).

implementedBy.settledEligibleRule: a pregame-researchEligible market lean with a DECISIVE official outcome (win|loss); pushes/pending/ambiguous/unsupported/ineligible + contextual research rows never count toward the 500-row gate
